description: v3 only. How one wallet's position in one vault moved over a window: total yield earned, plus a per-sample breakdown of balance, deposits and withdrawals. Use it to answer 'what has this vault actually paid me', which the current APR cannot - the APR is the rate now, this is what was received. Needs the vault address and its chain, both of which get_vaults returns.

chainId.description: Chain the vault is on, e.g. 1 for Ethereum.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v3': this tool exists on v3 only.

window.description: How far back to go (default week). These are the only buckets this endpoint has: there is no day and no six months, so ask for one of these rather than expecting the nearest.

name: get_vault_activity
title: A wallet's history in one Aave Vault
